tei:div.tei:p: ༈ ār+ya tā re na maḥ sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen pa dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sngon du song nas/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi sgo nas/ rang gzhan gyi rim gro tshe sgrub sogs kyis bsgyur dgos la/ hūm̐ las rgyas pa'i thab khung dkar po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyar khru do pa/ dpangs su khru gang pa/ kha khyer la rin po che dang ut+pala'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbyibs gru bzhi pa/ mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs par gyur/ bri bya la thab stegs med/ me lha sku mdog dmar po 'od zer ser po 'phro ba/ rigs bdag rin 'byung / spel tshig bdag gam sbyin pa'i bdag po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa la sogs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ khyad par gyi rdzas/ zas mchog 'bras/ so ba/ dūr ba rnams gang mang 'bul zhing grangs bsogs/ rdzas gzhan rnams kyang brgya rtsa brgyad re 'bul/ cho ga'i chings dang ngag 'don zhi ba dang 'dra'o/ /mnyam med kun dga' tshul khrims kyi zin tho gzhir bzhag nas/ dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bkod pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen pa dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
